comments.body: Not a 0.16.0 release blocker, so I removed the release-0.16.0 tag. rebar has never had `--version` (v0.15.1 lacks it too). `docs/releasing.md` §5 doesn't list it in the smoke test, and nothing delivered in 0.16.0 touches it. Adding it means adding a new CLI flag or subcommand, so it's a feature decision for the operator, not a bug fix. The options the release-candidate checker proposed: (1) a top-level `--version` printing the version and commit; (2) a `rebar version` subcommand with `-o json`; (3) close as wontfix. This ticket stays open until the operator chooses.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
`rebar --version` exits 1 with `Error: unknown subcommand '--version'` followed by the full subcommand list. No rebar command prints the installed version: `rebar --help`, `rebar config` and `rebar-mcp --help` do not show it. The only way to read it is `python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('nava-rebar'))"`, or `rebar._build_info.COMMIT` for the commit.

Observed 2026-11-13 during the 0.16.0 release-candidate check on origin/main d6ba771aabac872f018dc5906492639143b87d51, in both the editable worktree build and a wheel built with the hash-locked release toolchain (`REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=d6ba771`) installed into a fresh venv. v0.15.1 has no `--version` handling either, so this is not a regression. docs/releasing.md §5 does not list `rebar --version` in the smoke test; the release-candidate check list did.

## Why this needs an operator decision
The fix adds a new top-level CLI flag (or a `version` subcommand), which the bug-fix rule (no new config key, env var or flag in a fix) does not allow without an operator decision.

## Options
1. Add `--version` to the top-level parser, printing `rebar <version> (<commit>)` from `importlib.metadata` and `rebar._build_info.COMMIT`, and add it to `scripts/probe_rebar.py` and the release `wheel_test` job.
2. Add a `rebar version` subcommand instead (same output, with `-o json`).
3. Record the absence as intended and drop `rebar --version` from release check lists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The chosen option is recorded on this ticket. Checked: a comment naming the option.
- [ ] For options 1 and 2, `rebar --version` (or `rebar version`) exits 0 and prints the installed version from a wheel install. Checked: run it in a fresh venv.
